welcome.body: Send your prescription, get your tests verified, and come to the hospital only to give the sample.

book.photosBody: Up to 3 pages. Staff check your tests against it.
book.photosTip: Lay the paper flat in good light so the doctor's writing is readable.

book.needsPrescription: Some of these tests need a prescription photo. Go back and add one, or the request will be refused.
book.priceNote: Prices are final after staff verify your tests.

order.submittedBody: We'll check your tests and send the amount by SMS.
order.payBody: Pay at the hospital bank booth with this code — no paper needed. Online payment (bKash, Nagad, cards) is coming soon.
